speaker: Doctor
text: I need to clarify the nature of your right knee swelling. Has this been a lifelong issue, or did it start at a specific age or after an injury? Also, does the joint feel "stuck" or click when you move it?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis (Oligoarticular type).

Given the patient's age, isolated knee involvement, lack of trauma, and strong family history, this presentation is highly suggestive of early-onset inflammatory arthritis. I will need to confirm this with blood work to rule out infection or metabolic causes and assess for systemic inflammation.
